questions.question: Why is the Peninsular Plateau region of India more suitable for the occurrence of metallic minerals compared to the Indo-Gangetic plain?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Old crystalline and metamorphic rocks) है।

What is coelom in an organism?
options: It is the body cavity which is lined by mesoderm in animals.
It is the internal and external metameric segmentation in some animals.
It is the arrangement of cells in two embryonic layers in some animals.
